title: Phase 85 adds housing, shelter, land-use, and place-stability controls
summary: Eight inactive housing-delivery dossiers, eight tenure and affordability ledgers, eight shelter-supportive-housing and displacement registers, and eight retrofit-disaster-reconstruction and place-stability ledgers expose the complete housing contract without assigning, allocating, placing, relocating, scoring, ranking, or deciding for a household or community.
evidence_note: This release contains empty housing delivery, tenure, affordability, habitability, shelter, supportive-housing, displacement, retrofit, climate, disaster, relocation, reconstruction, return, and place-stability contracts plus synthetic-only validation. It contains no verified Phase 84 predecessor or Phase 85 decision or receipt.
publication_effect: Adds twelve Published briefings, six Published maps, one searchable registry with thirty-two detail routes, one public export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving all evidence, housing, household, community, emergency, and operating states unchanged.
